title: ACoworkAgentHub index entry
description: One entry of the generated index.json. The field names are intentionally aligned with the main repo's dev/common/sync-agent-hub.py output so the website pipeline can consume both without special-casing. Differences from the platform index: `category` is DERIVED from the package's labels through the hub's label->category map (the platform derives it from `role`), and the hub adds `labels`, `license`, `repository` and `deprecated`. The platform has no `tier` field and neither does this.

category.description: Derived by the hub from the package's labels via the label->category map in schema/catalog.json. Never declared by the author.

labels.description: The package's own retrieval tags (ADR-104). The secondary, cross-cutting facet.

skills.description: The skills that implement this capability (ADR-104).

publisher.description: Who published the agent to the hub. A provenance record, not a trust or endorsement claim — the hub renders no official badge.

license.description: SPDX expression for the agent's own content, from hub.json.

deprecated.description: Present when the agent is no longer recommended. The package stays published and verifiable; the site surfaces the notice.

source.description: Where the agent lives in this repository.

signature.description: Provenance of the package signature. 'official-channel' means the package was signed by a key listed in registry/trusted-keys.json AND has not been altered since signing. This is a distribution-channel marker, NOT an endorsement of the agent's quality, and it is never rendered as a trust badge. 'third-party' means the signature verified but the signer is not an official channel key. 'unsigned' means no signature. See docs/trust-model.md.

key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the signer's raw public key, hex-encoded. Matches the value printed by the main repo's acowork-verify.

catalog_digest_covered.description: Always true for signed packages: the labels the category is derived from live in manifest.toml, which is inside the digest list.
